Candidate.descriptor: The person a CV describes. One per CV; the anchor for everything the candidate claims.

attributes.headline: String
attributes.seniority: Enumeration: Internship, Entry level, Associate, Mid-Senior level, Director, Executive, Unknown

JobPosting.descriptor: An advertised position with the conditions an applicant must meet.

attributes.title: String
attributes.seniority: Enumeration: Internship, Entry level, Associate, Mid-Senior level, Director, Executive, Unknown
attributes.employment_type: Enumeration: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Temporary, Internship, Volunteer, Other

Company.descriptor: An organization that posts jobs or employed a candidate.

Occupation.descriptor: A standardized role from the O*NET-SOC taxonomy; lets differently worded titles meet.

Skill.descriptor: A capability a person can have and a job can ask for, normalized to an O*NET entry.

attributes.skill_type: Enumeration: Tool/Technology, Technical, Soft, Domain Knowledge, Language

Requirement.descriptor: One condition a posting places on applicants (a claim the candidate's evidence must satisfy).

attributes.requirement_type: Enumeration: Skill, Experience, Education, Credential, Other
attributes.education_level: Enumeration: High School, Associate, Bachelor, Master, Doctorate, None stated

Experience.descriptor: A role the candidate held for a period of time.

attributes.title: String
attributes.employment_type: Enumeration: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Temporary, Internship, Volunteer, Other

Credential.descriptor: A degree, certification, license or course the candidate earned.

attributes.name: String
attributes.level: Enumeration: High School, Associate, Bachelor, Master, Doctorate, None stated

Project.descriptor: A piece of work the candidate built, outside or within a role.

Location.descriptor: A place a job is based or a candidate lives; remote work is a location flag.

Evidence.descriptor: The exact source span a fact was extracted from. Every extracted fact must point to one.

relations.name: HAS_SKILL
relations.descriptor: The candidate claims this skill anywhere in the CV (attr: proficiency).

relations.name: EARNED
relations.descriptor: The candidate earned this degree, certification or license.

relations.name: AT
relations.descriptor: The role was held at this company.

relations.name: AS_ROLE
relations.descriptor: The role normalizes to this O*NET occupation.

relations.name: USED
relations.descriptor: The skill was applied in this role or project.

relations.name: FOR_ROLE
relations.descriptor: The job normalizes to this O*NET occupation.

relations.name: TARGETS
relations.descriptor: The requirement asks for this skill.

relations.name: RELATED_TO
relations.descriptor: The skills are closely related (attrs: source, weight, inferred=true when not from the taxonomy).

relations.name: TYPICAL_FOR
relations.descriptor: O*NET lists the skill as used in this occupation (attr: hot_technology).

relations.name: SUPPORTED_BY
relations.descriptor: The fact is grounded in this source span. Extracted relationships also carry evidence_ids.
